knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 传统贷款明细数据加工（科目映射+折人民币）
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
CREATE TABLE VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_01 AS
SELECT DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AS DATA_DT, T1.zckm, T1.qykm, T1.daikm, T1.dzkm,
  T.nor_principal, T.overdue_principal, T.slugg_principal, T.doubt_acct_principal,
  T.loan_bal*NVL(T5.dom_currcy_convt_price,1) AS loan_bal_rmb, ...
FROM CDM.C_AGT_LOAN_RCPT_INF T
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT T.prod_class_cd1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T.prod_featu_cd='ZHCHBJ' THEN T2.gl_subj_no END) AS zckm,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T.prod_featu_cd='YUQIBJ' THEN T2.gl_subj_no END) AS qykm,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T.prod_featu_cd='DZHIBJ' THEN T2.gl_subj_no END) AS daikm,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T.prod_featu_cd='DAIZBJ' THEN T2.gl_subj_no END) AS dzkm
  FROM FDM.F_FI_CRBS_NEW_ACCTG_ENTRY_CONFIG_FILE_BIZ T
  LEFT JOIN FDM.F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_NO_AND_CRBS_BIZ_NO_RELA T2 ON T.biz_cd_rule=T2.biz_cd
    AND T2.start_dt<=DATE AND T2.end_dt>DATE
  WHERE T.start_dt<=DATE AND T.end_dt>DATE AND T.prod_featu_cd IN('ZHCHBJ','YUQIBJ','DZHIBJ','DAIZBJ')
  GROUP BY T.prod_class_cd1
) T1 ON TRIM(T.acctg_class_cd)=TRIM(T1.prod_class_cd1)
LEFT JOIN C_COM_EXCH_RATE T5 ON T.currcy_cd=T5.currcy_cd AND T5.data_dt=DATE
WHERE T.data_dt=DATE AND t.loan_rcpt_no NOT LIKE 'FC%' AND (科目号以1开头) AND t.open_acct_dt<=DATE

-- 信贷数据
INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02
SELECT 'subj_no_zc', subj_no_zc, SUM(nor_principal_rmb) FROM VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_01 GROUP BY subj_no_zc
UNION ALL SELECT 'subj_no_yq', subj_no_yq, SUM(overdue_principal_rmb) ...
UNION ALL SELECT 'subj_no_dz', subj_no_dz, SUM(slugg_principal_rmb) ...
UNION ALL SELECT 'subj_no_dj', subj_no_dj, SUM(doubt_acct_principal_rmb) ...

-- 保理数据
INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02
SELECT 'baoli', CASE WHEN overdue_principal<>0 THEN '1313010100' WHEN slugg_principal<>0 THEN '1314010300' WHEN doubt_acct_principal<>0 THEN '1314010300' WHEN nor_principal<>0 THEN '1301030200' END, SUM(T1.loan_bal)
FROM C_AGT_LOAN_RCPT_INF T1 LEFT JOIN F_AC_CRMS_LOAN_BIZ_LOAN_RCPT T2
  ON T1.loan_rcpt_no=T2.loan_rcpt_no AND 拉链有效
WHERE T1.loan_rcpt_no LIKE 'FC%' AND biz_sts_cd NOT IN('18','19') AND loan_bal<>0
  AND prod_no NOT LIKE '1020%' AND SUBSTR(prod_no,1,1)='1'
  AND 排除特定借据 AND 排除特定产品

-- 贸易融资数据
INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02
SELECT 'myrz', '131299', SUM(T.p_amtz_intst*-1*NVL(T5.dom_currcy_convt_price,1))
FROM C_AGT_LOAN_RCPT_INF T LEFT JOIN C_COM_EXCH_RATE T5
  ON T.currcy_cd=T5.currcy_cd AND T5.data_dt=DATE
WHERE T.data_dt=DATE AND T.acctg_class_cd IN('1411','1333') AND T.p_amtz_intst<>0

-- 三方贷款
INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02
SELECT 'hlw', T4.gl_subj_no, SUM(T.debtor_bal-T.creditor_bal)
FROM F_AC_CRBS_SUB_LDGR T
INNER JOIN F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_NO_AND_CRBS_BIZ_NO_RELA T4 ON T.biz_cd=T4.biz_cd AND 拉链有效
WHERE 机构过滤(互联网贷款机构) AND T.subj_no LIKE '13%' AND T.subj_no NOT LIKE '1320%'

-- 信用卡贴现
INSERT INTO VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02
SELECT 'xyk&tx', T4.gl_subj_no, SUM(T.debtor_bal)-SUM(T.creditor_bal)
FROM F_FI_CRBS_BIZ_GL T
INNER JOIN F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_NO_AND_CRBS_BIZ_NO_RELA T4 ON T.biz_cd=T4.biz_cd
  AND (SUBSTR(T4.gl_subj_no,1,4) IN('1310','1309') OR SUBSTR(T4.gl_subj_no,1,6) IN('131305','131404'))
WHERE T.ETL_TX_DT=DATE AND T.gl_type_cd='0' AND T.debtor_bal-T.creditor_bal<>0

INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_TB_CHECK (check_no, check_desc, check_sub_no, check_sub_name, dtl_acct_bal, gl_bal, margin_val, check_dt)
SELECT '40002' AS check_no, '总分核对-传统贷款' AS check_desc,
  LEFT(A.subj_no,4) AS check_sub_no, C.subj_name AS check_sub_name,
  NVL(A.loan_bal,0) AS dtl_acct_bal, NVL(B.loan_bal,0) AS gl_bal,
  NVL(A.loan_bal,0)-NVL(B.loan_bal,0) AS margin_val, DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
FROM (
  SELECT LEFT(subj_no,4) AS SUBJ_NO, SUM(loan_bal_rmb) AS loan_bal
  FROM VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_LOAN_02 GROUP BY LEFT(subj_no,4) HAVING SUM(loan_bal_rmb)>0
) A
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT subj_no, SUM(debtor_bal), SUM(debtor_bal)-SUM(creditor_bal) AS loan_bal
  FROM CDM.C_FIN_GL_SUBJ_BAL
  WHERE data_dt=DATE AND org_no='0099' AND conve_into_currcy_cd<>'001'
    AND subj_no IN('1301','1302','1303','1304','1307','1308','1309','1310','1311','1312','1313','1314')
  GROUP BY subj_no HAVING SUM(debtor_bal)>0
) B ON A.subj_no = B.subj_no
LEFT JOIN FDM.F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_LVL_RELA C ON A.subj_no=C.subj_no AND 拉链有效 AND del_flag<>'D'
